layout_and_spacing.grid_product: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm
header.instructions: Must contain Logo/Brand name, navigation, and cart/CTA. Do not hide links on desktop.

product_card.style: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-sky-100 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col h-full
product_card.badge: absolute top-2 right-2 bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full
product_card.instructions: Ensure images don't stretch. Title should be truncated to 2 lines.

buttons.primary: bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-600 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95

whatsapp_chat.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center

forms.style: Shadcn UI inputs heavily customized to have rounded-xl borders, bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500 border-slate-200

badges.sale: bg-amber-500 text-white px-3 py-1 text-sm font-bold rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm

motion_and_interactions.page_load: framer-motion fade-in and slight slide-up staggered for grid items

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for UI icons. Install if not present.

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

hero_banner.description: Wide landscape hero banner for summer cooling fans, icy blue and white palette

products.description: Gray and white mini portable fan

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Cool Blue & White summer theme.
Ensure mobile-first design: product grid should be 2 columns on mobile.
Do NOT hide desktop navigation behind a hamburger menu.
Implement the COD order form heavily prioritizing ease of use, including fields for Name, Phone, WhatsApp, Address, and Location.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, dialogs, and admin tables, but override default gray borders with rounded-xl, sky-tinted borders.
Seed the database with 10 products using the provided product images and realistic Pakistani pricing (PKR).
Display prominent 5-80% summer sale discount badges on product cards.
